title: The Active tab lists terms in the fixed order, Credit Hold last
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • The shop has five active terms of its own: {Term-A} due 10 days after the invoice date, {Term-B} due 30 days after the invoice date, {Term-C} due on day 1 of the following month, {Term-D} due on day 22 of the following month, and {Term-E} due on day 1 of the following month. {Term-E}'s name comes after {Term-C}'s in A to Z order.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Ten, {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Thirty, {Term-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 First A, {Term-D} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Twentysecond and {Term-E} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 First B.
  • Other terms of the shop (from other tests) may also be listed; the checks below are about the order of the named rows.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Without clicking any column heading, read the Name column from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: COD is the first row, Due on Receipt the second and Credit Hold the last. In between, the Net terms (standard and the shop's own) run by number of days, lowest first: Net 7, then {Term-A} (10 days), then Net 15, Net 20, Net 30, then {Term-B} (30 days, after Net 30 because ties sort A to Z by name), then Net 45, Net 50, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120. After every Net term come the day-of-the-following-month terms by day: {Term-C}, then {Term-E} (both day 1, A to Z by name), then {Term-D} (day 22).

The order also has a place for "any other term A to Z" before Credit Hold; question 2 on Chris Ward's sheet (shared with him 23 Oct 2026) asks which terms those are. This case checks every kind a shop can create.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”
  • S1-R14: “The Active tab lists every active term; the Inactive tab lists every deactivated term, standard and the shop's own, in the same columns and order.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Active tab: one table"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

The design's own words:

  • “Order: COD, Due on Receipt, Net terms by days (the shop's own Net 10 sits between Net 7 and Net 15), "of the following month" terms by day, any other terms of the shop's own A to Z, Credit Hold last. Terms with the same days sort A to Z.”
